additional_info.subject: 0463099 - ID0463099-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312562229/25]Fail Safe Mode CRM:00314000249
additional_info.body:
Hello Antoine,
I am reaching out for ticket
ID0463099
which was re-opened for the failsafe mode appearing again on the charger.
We found the issue of the failsafe mode. In router XF3, there were blocked IPs from the Application board of the charger. As a result, the router was cutting the ssh communication with the charger:
Dec 11 08:59:49 sicharge-cp sicharge-cp-backend/d037cc4a13a4[824]: abort for request: https://10.20.17.1/ubus
Dec 11 08:59:49 sicharge-cp sicharge-cp-backend/d037cc4a13a4[824]: [routerLoginRPC] login to router failed {"type":"aborted","message":"The user aborted a request.","stack":"AbortError: The user aborted a request.\n    at abort (/node_modules/node-fetch/lib/index.js:1412:16)\n    at EventTarget.abortAndFinalize (/node_modules/node-fetch/lib/index.js:1427:4)\n    at [nodejs.internal.kHybridDispatch] (node:internal/event_target:820:20)\n    at EventTarget.dispatchEvent (node:internal/event_target:755:26)\n    at abortSignal (node:internal/abort_controller:370:10)\n    at AbortController.abort (node:internal/abort_controller:392:5)\n    at Timeout.<anonymous> (/dist/core/utils.js:35:58)\n    at listOnTimeout (node:internal/timers:581:17)\n    at process.processTimers (node:internal/timers:519:7)"}
The issue is now solved. I will proceed to close the ticket. Thank you!
With kind regards,
